sources.title: Audit Trails for Accountability in Large Language Models

inspection_spans.observation: Directly proposes chronological, tamper-evident, context-rich lifecycle and decision records with append-only storage and auditor-facing reconstruction, while acknowledging scale, composition, access, privacy, and proportionality limits.
inspection_spans.does_not_establish: That added records improve scientific decisions, human learning, calibrated beliefs, or held-out validity rather than documentation volume.
